Previous experience with server hardening within an AD environment is preferred. Identity & Access Management (IAM): Ability to integrate Active Directory with IAM solutions aligned with Zero Trust, identity governance, and adaptive authentication concepts . Previous experience with Okta/Auth0, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA , LDAPS preferred. Disaster Recovery: Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning for AD and its role within the organization's technology stacks.
